title: Amplify Hosting app: amplify.yml, monorepo build, production branch
description: Create the Amplify Hosting app connected to AnthusAI/Apricity and a production branch. Write amplify.yml for the web/ app (appRoot, npm ci, build, artifacts web/dist) and the Gen2 backend build (npx ampx pipeline-deploy). Settle first: web/dist needs the wasm module (npm run wasm uses cargo for wasm32-wasip1); decide between building it in the Amplify build image or publishing a prebuilt artifact, WITHOUT committing audio or large binaries. Hero and library audio are NOT in the build: they come from the S3 bucket via apricity sync. Depends on the USER task and on apricitus-f2fe8394 sandbox results.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Amplify web build reproducible: apricity-data storage feature (default on; web uses default-features=false, cli features=[storage]); wasm no longer has virtuus/aws/tokio in its tree. Added amplify.yml, customHttp.yml, scripts/amplify-wasm.sh, scripts/web-only-workspace.sh (Cargo reads sibling Virtuus path manifests even when unbuilt, so CI trims cli + virtuus dep). Verified in a clean clone without ../Virtuus: wasm builds. Not verified on the real Amplify Linux image.

comments.text: Committed. Reviewer re-ran cargo test (cli+data), wasm npm test, serve-smoke: pass; cargo tree for apricity-web has no virtuus/aws/tokio.
